decisions.reason: As an API-based SMS capability that fits the firm's existing cloud messaging, integration, and secure communications knowledge base and remained visibly marketed through 2024, management would likely retain it and continue learning from customer use.

The email-to-SMS gateway is a close extension of the firm's established hosted communication and workflow automation business, so its absorptive capacity is high enough to justify keeping it despite its short market history.

Although somewhat more niche and newly launched, the SMS-to-email gateway still draws directly on the firm's existing expertise in multichannel enterprise communication and can be improved through integration and customer feedback rather than dropped quickly.
